    2nd October, 17:30 - 16th October, 19:30

How to Join

SLBI Membership Fees

Annual membership of the SLBI costs just £25. You can set up an annual recurring subscription by filling out this form.

Add a donation to your membership and you will help us secure the future of plant learning in South London. If you are a UK tax payer, we can claim 25% Gift Aid on any amount you donate.
